title: UAEF: A framework-agnostic system for closed-loop evaluation of AI agents
headline: UAEF: A framework-agnostic system for closed-loop evaluation of AI agents
ai_overview: The Universal Agent Evaluation Framework (UAEF) is a framework-agnostic system for evaluating AI agents. UAEF converts each framework's traces into one canonical format, scores them with 36 built-in metrics across 7 dimensions, and stores results so teams can compare agent versions and catch regressions.
